perplexity.description:
Live at Scala is a live album by Paul Draper, recorded during his headline performance at London's Scala on September 21, 2017, and released in February 2018 on the Kscope label. The album captures Draper's energetic solo debut tour, which followed the commercial success of his first solo album that reached the top 20 of the UK charts. The performance showcases Draper's transition from his role as the ex-Mansun frontman to an established solo artist, drawing on the renewed interest in his 1990s work.

The twelve-track setlist balances material from Draper's solo work with selections from Mansun's catalog, including the band's classic tracks "Wide Open Space," "Disgusting," and "I Can Only Disappoint U." This mix demonstrates how effectively his new solo compositions stand alongside the material from Mansun's acclaimed 1997 debut album Attack of the Grey Lanterns. The album was mixed by Draper's longtime collaborator P Dub and released in multiple formats, including a limited-edition signed double 12" vinyl.

The live recording reflects the fervent response from Mansun's cult fanbase, whose online campaign drove demand for a second tour where Draper would perform both his solo album Spooky Action and the complete Attack of the Grey Lanterns. The album documents a pivotal moment in Draper's career, validating his solo endeavors while capitalizing on the enduring legacy of his previous band.
